# Getting help

- **Something does not work?** Start with the [Troubleshooting page](../docs/troubleshooting.md) and
  **CodeGent: Show Log** in VS Code.
- **A run cannot find ChatGPT's box, button or reply?** The ChatGPT page changes over time. In the
  browser extension's popup press **Test ChatGPT page**, then **Copy report**, and include it in a
  [bug report](https://github.com/MohammadAsadolahi/CodeGent/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).
- **Found a bug?** [Open an issue](https://github.com/MohammadAsadolahi/CodeGent/issues/new/choose).
- **Question, idea or show-and-tell?** Use
  [Discussions](https://github.com/MohammadAsadolahi/CodeGent/discussions).
- **Security problem?** Do not post it publicly; see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

Please never paste secrets, tokens or private code into an issue.
